name: Simon
bio: Simon, a sorcerer in Samaria who had amazed the people with his magic and claimed to be someone great, believed and was baptized after Philip preached Christ there. When Peter and John came to lay hands on the new believers so they might receive the Holy Spirit, Simon offered them money to buy this same power; Peter rebuked him sharply, telling him his heart was not right with God and his money would perish with him, and urged him to repent. Simon asked the apostles to pray for him (Acts 8:9-24). He is a different figure from Simon Peter and the other Simons in the New Testament.
